profile_text.body:
UC Berkeley / vLLM Team is a university research group, classified as a non-profit academic lab, that develops open-source infrastructure for large language model inference. The scraped website content reflects GitHub, the platform hosting the project, rather than a dedicated organizational site, so detail drawn directly from the group's own web presence is limited.

The team's primary product is vLLM, an open-source, self-hosted inference engine described as a high-throughput serving framework for language models. It is listed under the open source and self-hosted models category, and the held facts note that it involves no external data sharing. The project is hosted at github.com/vllm-project/vllm.

No litigation, patent filings, SEC records, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for this group.
